categories.reasoning: No consultations, actors or target groups are recorded in the document and no absence is acknowledged.

Links ln-awareness-better and ln-events-awareness have no rationale (IMP-LOG-001) and no assumption (IMP-LOG-002); the chain jumps from awareness (short_term) straight to oc-better-community (impact), skipping intermediate and long-term levels. No precondition or combination logic.
context.problemStatement is vague ("Our community has problems...") with no causes recorded; outcomes address no causes.
No assumptions or risks are stated at all (0 assumptions in the narrative), though both links depend on unstated ones.
int-events has no owner (IMP-INT-002); no partners or stances are identified.
All 7 elements have no basis recorded; no sources, evidence gaps, or provenance are given.
No target groups are named; oc-better-community and oc-awareness do not say who changes; ind-events is not disaggregated. Benefit is assumed.
A pathway diagram and narrative exist and agree with the model, but the glossary is empty ("defines no glossary terms") and outcomes are vague.

Holding events (oc-events) producing "people are aware" and then "the community is better" is unlikely as stated, with no mechanism, timing or lags; a skeptical stakeholder would not accept it. This is a judgment on the text as written.
int-events looks modest, but no resources, owner (IMP-INT-002) or ceiling of accountability (IMP-ACC-001) are examined, so feasibility cannot be confirmed.
oc-better-community and oc-awareness have no indicator; ind-events lacks baseline, target, source, frequency (IMP-MEA-002) and unit/direction (IMP-MEA-003). Outcomes cannot be measured as stated.
Lint overall is WARN with six unexplained warnings: IMP-ACC-001, IMP-INT-002, IMP-LOG-001, IMP-LOG-002, IMP-MEA-002, IMP-MEA-003; no errors reported.
